# Row visibility: IsValid drives whether a good's row shows in the window.

stl_row_vis_grain = {
	scope = state
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = stl_last_export_grain
			has_variable = stl_last_import_grain
			has_variable = stl_eff_export_grain
			has_variable = stl_eff_import_grain
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}

	is_valid = {
		OR = {
			has_variable = stl_last_export_opium
			has_variable = stl_last_import_opium
			has_variable = stl_eff_export_opium
			has_variable = stl_eff_import_opium
		}
	}
	ai_is_valid = { always = no }
}
